outcome: Infant temperament at 6 weeks and 9 months
cohort: Mothers and their healthy infants (n=452 at 6 weeks, n=258 at 9 months)
finding: The study largely failed to support an association between cesarean section and infant temperament, except for a possible association between emergency cesarean section and more difficult temperament at 6 weeks in firstborn infants.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section in firstborn infants was associated with more difficult temperament at 6 weeks.
